en.title: No Trump TV pool coverage today after he bans 3 major news outlets
en.summary: President Trump banned three major news outlets from the White House, resulting in no television pool coverage of him on Monday.

en.title: Trump reacts after CNN, MS NOW and Politico enter legal fight over White House access
en.summary: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are suing the Trump administration after losing White House press access. President Trump criticized the outlets, attributing their legal action to what he views as negative coverage.

stories.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas

en.summary: An ICE agent shot a 28-year-old Venezuelan national in Austin, Texas. The man was struck at least once in the torso and was reported in serious but stable condition.
